text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit parking at all times on the south side of Poplar Plains Crescent, between Poplar Plains Road and Rathnelly Avenue. As municipal sidewalks are not provided on either side of this roadway, the proposal to prohibit parking on the south side of the Poplar Plains Crescent, between Poplar Plains Road and Rathnelly Avenue, will enhance pedestrian safety and the two-way flow of vehicular traffic.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect from 2:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., Monday to Friday and from 2:00 a.m. to 5:00 a.m., Saturday and Sunday, on the south side of Poplar Plains Crescent, between Poplar Plains Road and Rathnelly Avenue. 2. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of Poplar Plains Crescent, between Poplar Plains Road and Rathnelly Avenue.
